chant.letra:
[Leader]
Open your mouth!
[Kids]
Aaah! Aaah!

[Leader]
Which tooth hurts?
[Kids]
This one! This one at the back!

[Leader]
What must you do?
[Kids]
Take the medicine! Sleep!

[Leader]
What mustn't you do?
[Kids]
Eat sweets! Not tonight!

[All]
Doctor, nurse and dentist too —
fruit and sleep will make you new!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
The nurse says open up and breathe,
the doctor writes it down.
The dentist counts your every tooth
and doesn't wear a frown.

[Chorus]
You must sleep and you must eat,
you mustn't stay up late!
Fruit and water, strong and healthy —
that's how you feel great!

[Verse 2]
When you're sick you stay at home,
the medicine goes down.
Two days later you are running
all the way to town.

[Chorus]
You must sleep and you must eat,
you mustn't stay up late!
Fruit and water, strong and healthy —
that's how you feel great!

[Bridge]
'Must' is not the same as 'want' —
but your body knows the difference.

[Chorus]
You must sleep and you must eat,
you mustn't stay up late!
Fruit and water, strong and healthy —
that's how you feel great!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Today we walk —
[Kids]
yesterday we WALKED!

[Leader]
Today we climb —
[Kids]
yesterday we CLIMBED!

[Leader]
Today we watch —
[Kids]
yesterday we WATCHED!

[Leader]
Today we help —
[Kids]
yesterday we HELPED!

[Leader]
And today we laugh —
[Kids]
yesterday we LAUGHED!

[All]
Visited, played and listened, jumped —
add the '-ed' and off we go!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Yesterday we visited the mountains,
we walked the whole way up.
We watched an eagle turning
and we drank from Erik's cup.

[Chorus]
Walked and climbed and watched and played,
listened, helped and laughed!
Add the '-ed' and it's yesterday —
that's the whole of the craft!

[Verse 2]
We camped beside the beach at night,
we jumped into the sea.
Sofía bought a souvenir
and forgot the sunscreen, obviously.

[Chorus]
Walked and climbed and watched and played,
listened, helped and laughed!
Add the '-ed' and it's yesterday —
that's the whole of the craft!

[Bridge]
Sightseeing all the afternoon,
and home again too soon.

[Chorus]
Walked and climbed and watched and played,
listened, helped and laughed!
Add the '-ed' and it's yesterday —
that's the whole of the craft!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Today I go —
[Kids]
yesterday I WENT!

[Leader]
Today I see —
[Kids]
yesterday I SAW!

[Leader]
Today I take —
[Kids]
yesterday I TOOK!

[Leader]
Today I find —
[Kids]
yesterday I FOUND!

[Leader]
Today I make —
[Kids]
yesterday I MADE!

[All]
Had and got and came and said —
no '-ed' on these, use your head!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Yesterday we went out early,
yesterday we saw the ice.
The morning air was freezing
and by noon it was quite nice.

[Chorus]
Went and saw and had and got,
came and took and found and made!
These ones never take an '-ed' —
they change, and that's the trade!

[Verse 2]
It was boiling in the valley,
it was humid by the stream.
By evening it was mild again
and the whole day felt a dream.

[Chorus]
Went and saw and had and got,
came and took and found and made!
These ones never take an '-ed' —
they change, and that's the trade!

[Bridge]
Valentina said the best line:
an adventure needs no plan.

[Chorus]
Went and saw and had and got,
came and took and found and made!
These ones never take an '-ed' —
they change, and that's the trade!

29.gramatica: past simple: telling a story in order

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Luna was lost. And then?
[Kids]
We looked for her! We looked everywhere!

[Leader]
And then?
[Kids]
We called her name! Luna! Luna!

[Leader]
And then?
[Kids]
We made a poster! We put it in the park!

[Leader]
And then?
[Kids]
We found her! Behind the bench!

[All]
Worried, then happy, then home —
one wet tail and never alone!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
We lost her on a Tuesday,
we looked for her till three.
We called her by the river
and we called her by the tree.

[Chorus]
Worried, worried, all afternoon,
then a tail behind a bench!
Lost and found and home again —
the happiest sound in the world!

[Verse 2]
We made a poster with her photo,
we put one in the park.
A woman phoned at half past five
and it wasn't even dark.

[Chorus]
Worried, worried, all afternoon,
then a tail behind a bench!
Lost and found and home again —
the happiest sound in the world!

[Bridge]
First, then, after that, at last —
that's how a story's told.

[Chorus]
Worried, worried, all afternoon,
then a tail behind a bench!
Lost and found and home again —
the happiest sound in the world!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Big —
[Kids]
BIGGER than!

[Leader]
Small —
[Kids]
SMALLER than!

[Leader]
Tall —
[Kids]
TALLER than!

[Leader]
Fast —
[Kids]
FASTER than!

[Leader]
Old —
[Kids]
OLDER than! And YOUNGER than!

[All]
Longer, shorter, slower too —
add the '-er' and add the 'than'!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Erik's taller than he was,
the winter's longer than the spring.
Sofía's rucksack's heavier
than almost anything.

[Chorus]
Bigger, smaller, faster, slower,
older, younger, shorter, longer!
Add the '-er' and add the 'than' —
and every day you're stronger!

[Verse 2]
A sprained ankle heals up faster
than a broken arm, they say.
An allergy is quieter
but it doesn't go away.

[Chorus]
Bigger, smaller, faster, slower,
older, younger, shorter, longer!
Add the '-er' and add the 'than' —
and every day you're stronger!

[Bridge]
Never say 'more big' — it's wrong.
Just add '-er' and move along.

[Chorus]
Bigger, smaller, faster, slower,
older, younger, shorter, longer!
Add the '-er' and add the 'than' —
and every day you're stronger!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Who is the tallest?
[Kids]
Tino! Tino is the tallest!

[Leader]
Who is the fastest?
[Kids]
Iris! Iris is the fastest!

[Leader]
Who is the funniest?
[Kids]
Mateo! Always Mateo!

[Leader]
And who is the best?
[Kids]
The class! The whole class!

[All]
Biggest, smallest, oldest, youngest —
everybody is the strongest!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
The biggest desk is by the window,
the smallest chair is at the back.
The oldest map is on the wall
and the youngest one is Bruno, that's a fact.

[Chorus]
The tallest, the fastest,
the funniest of all!
But the best thing in this classroom
is the class, and that's the call!

[Verse 2]
The strongest isn't strongest
when nobody's on his side.
The best is who helps somebody
when they've nowhere left to hide.

[Chorus]
The tallest, the fastest,
the funniest of all!
But the best thing in this classroom
is the class, and that's the call!

[Bridge]
One is bigger THAN the other.
One is THE biggest of them all.

[Chorus]
The tallest, the fastest,
the funniest of all!
But the best thing in this classroom
is the class, and that's the call!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
How many steps to the top?
[Kids]
Thirty! Thirty steps!

[Leader]
How many boats in the fjord?
[Kids]
Forty! Forty boats!

[Leader]
How many books on the shelf?
[Kids]
Sixty! Sixty books!

[Leader]
How many stars can you count?
[Kids]
Ninety! And then we lost count!

[All]
Twenty, fifty, seventy, eighty —
and a hundred if you're patient!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Twenty windows in the school,
thirty steps up to the door.
Forty boats out in the harbour
and fifty shells along the shore.

[Chorus]
How many? How many?
Count them, don't just guess!
Sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety —
a hundred, more or less!

[Verse 2]
Seventy pages in the notebook,
eighty minutes in the day.
Ninety birds above the water
and a hundred things to say.

[Chorus]
How many? How many?
Count them, don't just guess!
Sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety —
a hundred, more or less!

[Bridge]
After twenty they go in tens:
that's the trick and that's the end.

[Chorus]
How many? How many?
Count them, don't just guess!
Sixty, seventy, eighty, ninety —
a hundred, more or less!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
What's the time?
[Kids]
Eight o'clock! Time for school!

[Leader]
What's the time?
[Kids]
Half past ten! Time for break!

[Leader]
What's the time?
[Kids]
Quarter to one! Almost lunch!

[Leader]
And now?
[Kids]
Quarter past three! We're late! We're late!

[All]
Morning, afternoon and evening —
early, late, the clock keeps leaving!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
At eight o'clock the bus arrives,
at half past eight we're in.
At quarter past eleven
the maths lesson will begin.

[Chorus]
What's the time? Look at the clock!
O'clock, half past, quarter to!
Morning, afternoon and evening —
the watch says what to do!

[Verse 2]
Mateo's early once a year
and late the other days.
At night he sets three different alarms
and sleeps through all of them anyway.

[Chorus]
What's the time? Look at the clock!
O'clock, half past, quarter to!
Morning, afternoon and evening —
the watch says what to do!

[Bridge]
When? At six. When? Half past nine.
Answer 'when' and you'll be fine.

[Chorus]
What's the time? Look at the clock!
O'clock, half past, quarter to!
Morning, afternoon and evening —
the watch says what to do!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Spring!
[Kids]
Flowers! Rain and sunshine!

[Leader]
Summer!
[Kids]
Hot! The longest days!

[Leader]
Autumn!
[Kids]
Wind! Leaves and cloud!

[Leader]
Winter!
[Kids]
Snow! Snow on the mountain!

[All]
Rainbow after every season —
four of them and each a reason!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
In spring the first green leaf appears
and there's sunshine after rain.
In summer the cloud has gone away
and the fjord is blue again.

[Chorus]
Spring, summer, autumn, winter,
four times every year!
Wind and snow and sun and rainbow —
each one bringing something dear!

[Verse 2]
In autumn the wind takes the leaves
and the season turns to gold.
In winter snow comes down at four
and everything is cold.

[Chorus]
Spring, summer, autumn, winter,
four times every year!
Wind and snow and sun and rainbow —
each one bringing something dear!

[Bridge]
Which season do you like the most?
There isn't any wrong.

[Chorus]
Spring, summer, autumn, winter,
four times every year!
Wind and snow and sun and rainbow —
each one bringing something dear!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Whose robot is this?
[Kids]
Erik's! It's Erik's robot!

[Leader]
Whose kite is this?
[Kids]
Sofía's! It's Sofía's kite!

[Leader]
Whose ball is this?
[Kids]
Mine! It's mine!

[Leader]
And whose is that one?
[Kids]
Yours! That one is yours!

[All]
Doll and game and toy and owner —
put an 's' and you're the owner!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Whose game is on the table?
It's Valentina's, I am sure.
Whose robot lost a wheel again?
It's Erik's, that's for sure.

[Chorus]
Whose is it? Add an 's'!
Mateo's kite, Sofía's ball!
Mine and yours and hers and his —
an owner for them all!

[Verse 2]
The doll belongs to nobody,
it lives in the box downstairs.
The toy that everybody shares
is the toy that everybody cares for.

[Chorus]
Whose is it? Add an 's'!
Mateo's kite, Sofía's ball!
Mine and yours and hers and his —
an owner for them all!

[Bridge]
One small mark above the line
turns 'Erik' into 'Erik's' — that's mine!

[Chorus]
Whose is it? Add an 's'!
Mateo's kite, Sofía's ball!
Mine and yours and hers and his —
an owner for them all!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
What do you want to do?
[Kids]
We want to make a party!

[Leader]
When?
[Kids]
Tomorrow! No — next week!

[Leader]
Who would you like to invite?
[Kids]
Everybody! The whole class!

[Leader]
And what mustn't we do?
[Kids]
TELL HER! Shh! Shh!

[All]
Plan the list and get it ready —
soon, soon, hold it steady!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
We want to make a birthday party,
we would like to keep it quiet.
Erik's got a plan on paper
and Mateo's going to try it.

[Chorus]
I want to, I'd like to,
tomorrow or next week!
Prepare the list, invite them all
and nobody must speak!

[Verse 2]
The cake is ready by the window,
the room is ready, more or less.
She's coming up the stairs right now —
and Mateo says 'Surprise!' — too soon, I guess.

[Chorus]
I want to, I'd like to,
tomorrow or next week!
Prepare the list, invite them all
and nobody must speak!

[Bridge]
'I want' is strong, 'I'd like' is kind —
both of them say what's on your mind.

[Chorus]
I want to, I'd like to,
tomorrow or next week!
Prepare the list, invite them all
and nobody must speak!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
What is Valentina doing?
[Kids]
She is singing! Right now!

[Leader]
What is Erik doing?
[Kids]
He is dancing! Badly!

[Leader]
What is the audience doing?
[Kids]
They are clapping! Louder!

[Leader]
And the curtain?
[Kids]
It is opening! Now! Now!

[All]
Stage and lights and costume, show —
it is starting, here we go!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
The lights are going down,
the curtain's moving slow.
Sofía's fixing her costume
thirty seconds from the show.

[Chorus]
She is singing, he is dancing,
they are acting on the stage!
The audience is clapping —
it is happening at this age!

[Verse 2]
Mateo's looking for his hat
and it's already on his head.
The music's starting anyway
and nobody has fled.

[Chorus]
She is singing, he is dancing,
they are acting on the stage!
The audience is clapping —
it is happening at this age!

[Bridge]
Not 'she sings' — she IS singing.
Right now, while the lights are ringing.

[Chorus]
She is singing, he is dancing,
they are acting on the stage!
The audience is clapping —
it is happening at this age!

chant.letra:
[Leader]
Listen!
[Kids]
We're listening!

[Leader]
Look!
[Kids]
We're looking!

[Leader]
Stop! Wait!
[Kids]
Stopping! Waiting!

[Leader]
Sit down! Stand up!
[Kids]
Down! Up! Down! Up!

[Leader]
And on the stairs?
[Kids]
Don't run! Be careful!

[All]
Open, close and quiet please —
say it once and say it clear!

cancion.letra:
[Verse 1]
Open the window, close the door,
wait a moment, look around.
Don't run along the corridor —
be careful with that sound.

[Chorus]
Do this, don't do that!
Stop and wait and listen!
Sit down, stand up, open, close —
one short word, no discussion!

[Verse 2]
Don't shout at somebody smaller,
don't laugh when someone's hurt.
Do help them up and say you're sorry —
that's a rule that's worth the work.

[Chorus]
Do this, don't do that!
Stop and wait and listen!
Sit down, stand up, open, close —
one short word, no discussion!

[Bridge]
An order isn't being rude
when 'please' is in your attitude.

[Chorus]
Do this, don't do that!
Stop and wait and listen!
Sit down, stand up, open, close —
one short word, no discussion!
